transcript: If you have a good heart and sincere intentions, you are not the one who loses people. They are the ones who lose you, because people with a good heart are hard to find. They are people who want to see you win, who genuinely wish you the best, even when you're no longer part of their life, who act from a place of care and not from self-interest, especially when you are not around. And if someone decides to walk away from that, it is their choice, and it is completely valid. But never confuse a loss with a redirection, because sometimes life is not taking people away from you. It is making room for the ones who truly deserve to be by your side. In our monastery, I learned that the people who leave do not always get lost. Sometimes they simply completed their cycle. They came to teach you something, and when the lesson was over, the bond was too. It is not rejection, it is evolution. Not everyone who leaves abandons you. Some simply could not keep walking at your pace, and that is okay. Stay with whoever chooses you daily, not with whoever you have to convince to stay. Write in the comments, good heart. If this described you, but I want you to understand something, if every time someone leaves you feel like something was torn out of you, if letting go is hard, if you keep thinking about people who are no longer there, that is not love, it is a void. A void you have been trying to fill for years with the presence of others. The stress of living focused on who stays and who goes consumes you. It steals the peace you say you want. It keeps you attached to people who have already chosen to leave, and as long as you keep filling yourself with others, you will keep emptying yourself every time they go. The day you fill that void from within you, stop needing anyone to stay in order to feel whole. And if you want to learn how to fill yourself from within, so that what comes adds to you and what leaves does not destroy you, I have spent more than 20 years learning in silence how to do it, and everything I know is inside the road back to calm. The link is in my profile.
